# Error codes

Every error code `tomaccoctl` returns, 459 codes, generated from `assets/errors.json`. A failure is `{"ok":false,"error":{"code":...,"message":...,"remedy":...}}`, and over MCP the same object under `structuredContent.error`. Branch on `code`. The message says what happened this time; when the place that failed has no remedy of its own, `remedy` is the general one below. In the middle column, … stands for a value the message fills in. [All operations](README.md).

| Code | What it means | What to do |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `action_unsupported` | project.dependency_updates reads Gradle builds, pubspec.yaml, package.json dependencies and Package.resolved; this project has none. | Use an explicitly configured project task for framework-specific commands. |
| `adb_forward` | ADB did not allocate a forwarding port. | Check with device.list that the device is online, then stop the session with runtime.stop and start it again. |
| `ambiguous_selector` | Selector matched … elements; refine it or specify index. | Add properties to the selector, or pass index. |
| `analyzer_failed` | No analyser produced a result; see report.json. | Read the message and the job's log (job.logs); fix the cause and try again. |
| `analyzer_output` | dart analyze printed no JSON. | Read the message, change what it names and try again; docs/troubleshooting.md lists known errors. |
| `android_project_missing` | No Gradle project in …/android. | Check the name or path in the message; the matching list operation (device.list, job.list, workspace.list, catalog.list) shows what exists, and doctor what is set up. |
| `app_action_failed` | Device action failed. | Read the message and the job's log (job.logs); fix the cause and try again. |
| `app_container_unavailable` | The iPhone did not open the container of … | Read the message, change what it names and try again; docs/troubleshooting.md lists known errors. |
| `app_crashed` | … … during the scenario. | Read the crash with testing.crashes or device.logs, fix it and run again. |
| `app_not_built` | Expected one xtool/\*.app in …, found … | Run project.execute with platform ios for an xtool project, and wait for its job. |
| `app_not_debuggable` | Android refused run-as for this app; install a debuggable build for the current primary user. | Install a debuggable build of the app, such as a debug build from project.run. |
| `app_not_installed` | … is not installed. | Install the app with device.install or project.run. |
| `app_not_running` | … is not running. | Launch the app first, for example with device.app. |
| `apple_companion_failed` | A display session with a device did not start or stopped answering. | Check with device.list that the device is online, then stop the session with runtime.stop and start it again. |
| `apple_companion_timeout` | The Mac simulator did not become ready within 75 seconds. | Check with device.list that the device is online, then stop the session with runtime.stop and start it again. |
| `apple_runtime` | A display session with a device did not start or stopped answering. | Check with device.list that the device is online, then stop the session with runtime.stop and start it again. |
| `application_id_ambiguous` | Several installed apps match … | Pass the exact bundle_id from ios.apps. |
| `application_id_required` | The request was refused; the message says why. | Pass bundle_id with the app's bundle identifier. |
| `application_id_unknown` | The build files do not state this app's application ID. | Pass bundle_id with the app's application ID. |
| `approval_denied` | The desktop asked the person about a destructive agent call and they denied it, pressed Escape, or the request timed out. | Ask the person, or have them approve it in the Tomacco window; desktop approval is set with settings.configure approval. |
| `artifact_missing` | Screenshot command produced no artifact. | Check the name or path in the message; the matching list operation (device.list, job.list, workspace.list, catalog.list) shows what exists, and doctor what is set up. |
| `audio_stopping` | The previous audio stream is still stopping; retry shortly. | Check with device.list that the device is online, then stop the session with runtime.stop and start it again. |
| `audio_unsupported` | Output forwarding is currently available for Android 11 and newer. | Check with device.list that the device is online, then stop the session with runtime.stop and start it again. |
| `authentication_failed` | Google did not return an access token. | Check that the service-account key is valid and has access in Play Console. |
| `avd_exists` | An emulator with that name exists. | Choose another name, or use the existing one with android.avd_start. |
| `avd_in_use` | Stop the emulator before changing its hardware settings. | Unrecognized emulator lock files are preserved. |
| `avd_not_found` | Unknown AVD: … | Use android.avds or android.avd_create. |
| `baseline_conflict` | Two devices would write different screenshots to the same baseline file. | Approve the screens one device at a time, or give each device its own baselines folder. |
| `baseline_missing` | No baseline at … | Create the baseline with update_baseline:true after checking the image is right. |
| `baselines_missing` | record_baselines ran screen steps whose baselines did not exist yet; it saved the screens instead of comparing them. | Review them with testing.baselines review and approve them, then run the scenario again. |
| `binary_file` | This file is not UTF-8 text. | files.read and files.write handle UTF-8 text only. |
| `budget_exceeded` | Outside the performance budget: … | Compare the report with its baseline (profile.compare) to find the regression, or raise the budget if it was intended. |
| `builtin_profile` | The request was refused; the message says why. | Choose a new ID; built-in profiles cannot be replaced. |
| `bundle_id_mismatch` | The built app is …, not … | Read the message, change what it names and try again; docs/troubleshooting.md lists known errors. |
| `bundletool_failed` | bundletool reported no sizes. | Read the message and the job's log (job.logs); fix the cause and try again. |
| `capture_failed` | Evidence capture failed. | Check with device.list that the device is online, then stop the session with runtime.stop and start it again. |
| `capture_incomplete` | Device screenshot has not completed successfully. | Inspect job.get and job.logs. |
| `capture_not_running` | android.network_capture stop or summary was called with no capture running on that device. | Start one with android.network_capture start and opt_in true. |
| `capture_running` | A network capture is already running on that device. | Stop it with android.network_capture stop before starting another. |
| `capture_timeout` | ADB screenshot timed out. | Check with device.list that the device is online, then stop the session with runtime.stop and start it again. |
| `catalogue_full` | At most 1000 custom profiles are supported. | Read the message, change what it names and try again; docs/troubleshooting.md lists known errors. |
| `checksum_mismatch` | The download from … does not match its published checksum and was deleted. | Try again; if it repeats, the download source changed and the pinned checksum needs an update in a new Tomacco version. |
| `config_unsupported` | The request was refused; the message says why. | Update the bundle identifier in this project's xtool configuration manually. |
| `conflicting_display_profile` | This device model has its own display; omit display_profile. | Read the message; ios.virtual.status and the job's log show the device's state, and docs/virtual-ios/troubleshooting.md lists known causes. |
| `conflicting_storage` | The virtual iOS device or its research engine refused the request or stopped answering. | Select one access mode per virtual disk. |
| `consent_declined` | The person said no, or closed the question, when the MCP client asked them before this step. | Do not repeat the call unless the person changes their mind; ask them what to do instead. |
| `console_log_limit` | Guest console exceeded 8 MiB. | Read the message; ios.virtual.status and the job's log show the device's state, and docs/virtual-ios/troubleshooting.md lists known causes. |
| `coverage_not_configured` | coverage was asked for, but the module's build files enable no coverage report (no enableUnitTestCoverage, jacoco or Kover). | Add the line the error names to the module's build file, then run again. |

| `runtime_busy` | Runtime input queue is full. | Check with device.list that the device is online, then stop the session with runtime.stop and start it again. |
| `runtime_configuration_conflict` | This device already has a native session with different stream settings. | Reuse the existing session, or stop it before changing stream settings. |
| `runtime_directory` | Runtime sockets require an owner-only directory. | Check with device.list that the device is online, then stop the session with runtime.stop and start it again. |
| `runtime_protocol` | Runtime response exceeded its limit. | Check with device.list that the device is online, then stop the session with runtime.stop and start it again. |
| `runtime_required` | No connected iPhone session for … | Start one with runtime.start platform=ios, device and runner_bundle_id, then run the scenario. |
| `runtime_start_failed` | A display session with a device did not start or stopped answering. | Check with device.list that the device is online, then stop the session with runtime.stop and start it again. |
| `runtime_start_timeout` | Native runtime is still starting; inspect runtime.state. | Check with device.list that the device is online, then stop the session with runtime.stop and start it again. |
| `runtime_stopped` | Connection was cancelled. | Check with device.list that the device is online, then stop the session with runtime.stop and start it again. |
| `runtime_timeout` | Device did not answer. | Check with device.list that the device is online, then stop the session with runtime.stop and start it again. |
| `runtime_unavailable` | A display session with a device did not start or stopped answering. | Connect the Android runtime before enabling audio. |
| `scenario_failed` | One or more device scenarios failed; inspect report.json and screenshots. | Read the job's report.json and screenshots for the failing step. |
| `scenario_missing` | Something the request names does not exist or is not set up. | Save a scenario file in this workspace first. |
| `scrcpy_failed` | Android display server exited: … | Check with device.list that the device is online, then stop the session with runtime.stop and start it again. |
| `scrcpy_protocol` | Expected scrcpy 4.1 display metadata. | Check with device.list that the device is online, then stop the session with runtime.stop and start it again. |
| `scrcpy_server_missing` | The native Android view requires the scrcpy 4.1 server. | Install scrcpy 4.1 or pass the server JAR path to runtime.start. |
| `scrcpy_timeout` | Android display server did not connect. | Check with device.list that the device is online, then stop the session with runtime.stop and start it again. |
| `screen_not_found` | No screen with this id is in the run being reviewed. | List the ids with testing.baselines review. |
| `screenshot_missing` | The screenshot the review names is gone from the run directory. | Run the scenario again with record_baselines. |
| `sdk_missing` | Configure the Android SDK first. | Set android_sdk with settings.configure. |
| `sdk_platform_missing` | Something the request names does not exist or is not set up. | Install an Android platform with android.sdk_install, then build again. |
| `secret_permissions` | The App Store Connect .p8 key must be readable only by its owner. | chmod 600 the file. |
| `server_failed` | … exited (…) before it listened on port … | Read the message and the job's log (job.logs); fix the cause and try again. |
| `server_timeout` | Nothing listened on port … within … s. | Check that it is still running and reachable, then try once more. |
| `session_job_limit` | This MCP session already runs as many jobs as jobs_per_session allows. | Wait for a job to end with job.wait, or cancel one with job.cancel. |
| `setting_not_applied` | Android did not apply: … | Read the message, change what it names and try again; docs/troubleshooting.md lists known errors. |
| `setting_unsupported` | Switching airplane mode from adb needs Android 11 (API 30) or newer. | Older Android changes the language only for the whole device, in its Settings app. |
| `setup_failed` | HOME is not set. | Run tomaccoctl setup from a normal login shell with HOME set. |
| `step_failed` | … failed (…). | Read the message and the job's log (job.logs); fix the cause and try again. |
| `step_unsupported` | Step …: … | Read the message, change what it names and try again; docs/troubleshooting.md lists known errors. |
| `storage_flush_unverified` | Engine did not confirm flushing the disposable image. | Read the message; ios.virtual.status and the job's log show the device's state, and docs/virtual-ios/troubleshooting.md lists known causes. |
| `store_key_incomplete` | key_id, issuer_id and key_path go together. | Pass key_id, issuer_id and key_path together, or none of them. |
| `store_key_required` | An upload needs key_id, issuer_id and key_path. | Create a team key under Users and Access &gt; Integrations in App Store Connect, and the app record once. |
| `store_request_failed` | Google Play request failed (HTTP …). | Read the HTTP status and Google's message; a 403 usually means the service account lacks permission for the app. |
| `store_response_invalid` | Google did not return a bundle version code. | Correct the value the message names; tomaccoctl schema OPERATION lists accepted arguments. |
| `swift_sdk_unconfigured` | Swift SDK is not connected to an Android NDK. | Run swift.android_configure after installing the matching NDK. |
| `system_packages_missing` | Missing: … | Check the name or path in the message; the matching list operation (device.list, job.list, workspace.list, catalog.list) shows what exists, and doctor what is set up. |
| `temporary_directory_changed` | Temporary directory identity changed; preserved replacement. | Read the message, change what it names and try again; docs/troubleshooting.md lists known errors. |
| `terminal_missing` | Something the request names does not exist or is not set up. | Run xtool auth login in a terminal yourself; only the person signs in. |
| `test_runtime_required` | The request was refused; the message says why. | Run portable Swift unit tests on Linux; Android behavior needs a device integration test. |
| `text_requires_accessibility` | For non-ASCII text use runtime.input action=fill with the field coordinates; this replaces its full accessible value. | Check with device.list that the device is online, then stop the session with runtime.stop and start it again. |
| `text_too_long` | Text through the clipboard is limited to {PASTE_LIMIT} bytes. | Check with device.list that the device is online, then stop the session with runtime.stop and start it again. |
| `text_unsupported` | Text outside ASCII goes through the device clipboard, which needs the scrcpy 4.1 server. | Configure scrcpy with settings.configure, or run testing.setup and use testing.action with fill. |
| `tool_failed` | A tool Tomacco ran exited with an error. | Read the tool's output in the message or the job's log (job.logs) and fix its cause. |
| `tool_missing` | A tool the operation needs is not installed or not configured. | Install it as doctor's next_steps say, or point settings.configure executables at it, then call again. |
| `tool_output` | A tool printed something Tomacco could not read. | Run the tool by hand in the project to see its own error; an outdated tool version is a common cause. |
| `tool_start_failed` | A tool could not be started. | Check that the configured path is an executable file (settings.get, doctor) and that the host has the libraries it needs. |
| `tool_timeout` | A tool Tomacco ran did not finish in its time. | Check that the device or network it needs is reachable, then try again; a job's timeout argument can give it longer. |
| `toolkit_missing` | The pinned omarchy-apple-dev checkout has no … | Check the name or path in the message; the matching list operation (device.list, job.list, workspace.list, catalog.list) shows what exists, and doctor what is set up. |
| `toolkit_sdk_missing` | The private toolchain has no current SDK. An SDK from ios.sdk_install does not count: the pinned xtool fork refuses its older stamp. | Check the name or path in the message; the matching list operation (device.list, job.list, workspace.list, catalog.list) shows what exists, and doctor what is set up. |
| `toolkit_toolchain_missing` | The private omarchy-apple-dev toolchain is not installed. | Check the name or path in the message; the matching list operation (device.list, job.list, workspace.list, catalog.list) shows what exists, and doctor what is set up. |
| `trace_output` | Unterminated trace processor CSV value. | Read the message, change what it names and try again; docs/troubleshooting.md lists known errors. |
| `transport_failed` | The MCP server could not write to its client. | Restart the client's connection to tomaccoctl mcp. |
| `ui_hierarchy_unavailable` | … needs a UI hierarchy, and the virtual iPhone's guest tools do not report one. | Use testing.run with tap, swipe, text, key, wait_screen and assert_screen steps, or ios.emulator.control with coordinates. |
| `unsafe_data_directory` | The Tomacco data directory is not a directory owned by this user: … | Set TOMACCO_HOME to a directory you own. |
| `unsafe_runtime_directory` | Runtime directory is not a private directory of this user: … | Remove it, or set TMPDIR to a directory only you can write. |
| `unsigned_artifact` | Bundle signature could not be verified. | Read the message, change what it names and try again; docs/troubleshooting.md lists known errors. |
| `unsupported_artifact` | The input is of a kind this operation does not support. | Select an APK or AAB. |
| `unsupported_boot_display` | This engine does not provide the guest boot framebuffer; rebuild the SPTM engine with Tomacco's patch. | Read the message; ios.virtual.status and the job's log show the device's state, and docs/virtual-ios/troubleshooting.md lists known causes. |
| `unsupported_boot_media` | This engine cannot register the RAM image with IOMedia; rebuild the SPTM engine with Tomacco's patch. | Read the message; ios.virtual.status and the job's log show the device's state, and docs/virtual-ios/troubleshooting.md lists known causes. |
| `unsupported_codec` | Android did not negotiate H.264. | Check with device.list that the device is online, then stop the session with runtime.stop and start it again. |
| `unsupported_engine` | Guest commands require the Darwin/SPTM restore-shell backend. | Read the message; ios.virtual.status and the job's log show the device's state, and docs/virtual-ios/troubleshooting.md lists known causes. |
| `unsupported_firmware` | No matching board/variant erase identity in the firmware. | Read the message; ios.virtual.status and the job's log show the device's state, and docs/virtual-ios/troubleshooting.md lists known causes. |
| `unsupported_image` | The input is of a kind this operation does not support. | Pass one of the supported kinds the message or the operation's schema names. |
| `unsupported_input` | This action is not supported by the Android runtime. | Check with device.list that the device is online, then stop the session with runtime.stop and start it again. |
| `unsupported_key` | Unknown Android key. | Check with device.list that the device is online, then stop the session with runtime.stop and start it again. |
| `unsupported_native_arch` | The ELF architecture is not supported by the Android NDK debugger. | Check the session with debug.list and its log; the app must be a debuggable build that is running. |
| `unsupported_step` | … is not available on the virtual iPhone. | Pass one of the supported kinds the message or the operation's schema names. |
| `unsupported_working_image` | Working images require boot_media=true and an engine providing boot-storage. | Read the message; ios.virtual.status and the job's log show the device's state, and docs/virtual-ios/troubleshooting.md lists known causes. |
| `update_auto_off` | Updates are not set to install by themselves. | Read the message; update.status shows the update state, and Tomacco keeps the installed version when an update is refused. |
| `update_busy` | An update is being installed right now. | Wait for the running installation to end; update.status shows it. |
| `update_check_failed` | Checking for, downloading or installing an update did not work. | Read the message; update.status shows the update state, and Tomacco keeps the installed version when an update is refused. |
| `update_checksum_mismatch` | Refused the update: the package does not match its published checksum. Nothing was installed. | Read the message; update.status shows the update state, and Tomacco keeps the installed version when an update is refused. |
| `update_download_failed` | Downloading … failed: GitHub answered with status …. | Read the message; update.status shows the update state, and Tomacco keeps the installed version when an update is refused. |
| `update_forced_off` | Checking for, downloading or installing an update did not work. | Read the message; update.status shows the update state, and Tomacco keeps the installed version when an update is refused. |
| `update_health_check_failed` | Checking for, downloading or installing an update did not work. | Read the message; update.status shows the update state, and Tomacco keeps the installed version when an update is refused. |
| `update_held` | This version failed to install or was rolled back, so it is not installed by itself again. | Install it with update.apply manual:true only if the person wants to try it again. |
| `update_install_failed` | The installer reported no journal for this installation. | Read the message; update.status shows the update state, and Tomacco keeps the installed version when an update is refused. |
| `update_installer_failed` | Checking for, downloading or installing an update did not work. | Read the message; update.status shows the update state, and Tomacco keeps the installed version when an update is refused. |
| `update_invalid_package` | Refused the update: …. Nothing was installed. | Read the message; update.status shows the update state, and Tomacco keeps the installed version when an update is refused. |
| `update_no_package` | Release … has no package …. | Read the message; update.status shows the update state, and Tomacco keeps the installed version when an update is refused. |
| `update_no_release` | No release is available yet. | Nothing to do until a release is published. |
| `update_not_available` | No newer version is known yet. | Nothing to do: this is the newest known version. |
| `update_not_newer` | Release … is not newer than …; an update never downgrades. | Nothing to do: an update never downgrades. |
| `update_nothing_to_roll_back` | There is no installed update to roll back. | Nothing to do: no update was installed. |
| `update_off` | Updates are turned off. Install one from the Settings, or pass manual when the user asked for it. | Pass manual:true only when the person asked for this update. |
| `update_offline` | GitHub could not be reached during the download. This computer may be offline. | Connect to the network and try again. |
| `update_rollback_failed` | The update failed (…) and restoring the previous version failed too (…). Its files are in the backup …. | Run the installer with --rollback and this backup ID, or install again. |
| `update_signature_invalid` | Refused the update: …. Nothing was installed. | Correct the value the message names; tomaccoctl schema OPERATION lists accepted arguments. |
| `update_signing_key_missing` | This build of {PRODUCT_NAME} has no release signing key, so it cannot verify an update and will not install one. | Read the message; update.status shows the update state, and Tomacco keeps the installed version when an update is refused. |
| `update_too_large` | Refused …: it exceeds the size limit. | Read the message; update.status shows the update state, and Tomacco keeps the installed version when an update is refused. |
| `update_unsafe_package` | Refused the update: …. Nothing was installed. | Read the message; update.status shows the update state, and Tomacco keeps the installed version when an update is refused. |
| `update_unsigned` | Refused the update: release … has no signature (….sig). Nothing was installed. | Read the message; update.status shows the update state, and Tomacco keeps the installed version when an update is refused. |
| `update_unwritable` | … cannot be written (…). | Read the message; update.status shows the update state, and Tomacco keeps the installed version when an update is refused. |
| `update_wrong_host` | Refused the download address …: it is not this project's. | Read the message; update.status shows the update state, and Tomacco keeps the installed version when an update is refused. |
| `variable_missing` | JDWP expressions support local variables and field paths. | Check the session with debug.list and its log; the app must be a debuggable build that is running. |
| `variant_required` | This app has product flavors; name the build variant to install. | Pass variant with one of the build variants the message lists. |
| `verify_unreadable` | Verification failed: … | Read the message, change what it names and try again; docs/troubleshooting.md lists known errors. |
| `version_ambiguous` | Expected exactly one …, found … | Read the message, change what it names and try again; docs/troubleshooting.md lists known errors. |
| `version_unsupported` | Info.plist is not an XML property list. | Read the message, change what it names and try again; docs/troubleshooting.md lists known errors. |
| `video_protocol` | Invalid Android video packet length. | Check with device.list that the device is online, then stop the session with runtime.stop and start it again. |
| `worker_reaper_unavailable` | The request was refused; the message says why. | Read the message, change what it names and try again; docs/troubleshooting.md lists known errors. |
| `worker_start_failed` | A step Tomacco ran did not succeed. | Read the message and the job's log (job.logs); fix the cause and try again. |
| `workflow_needs_confirmation` | A workflow.run step is destructive or publishes and has no confirm. | Tell the person what those steps delete, overwrite or publish, and set confirm:true on each only after they agree. |
| `workflow_step_failed` | A workflow.run step failed or its job did not succeed; the later steps did not run. | Read details.steps for that step's error or job, fix the cause and run the workflow again. |
| `workflow_timed_out` | workflow.run ran out of its timeout while following a job. | The job keeps running: follow it with job.wait, or stop it with job.cancel. |
| `working_image_changed` | Working image was replaced before the job started. | Read the message; ios.virtual.status and the job's log show the device's state, and docs/virtual-ios/troubleshooting.md lists known causes. |
| `working_image_flush_failed` | Engine did not confirm flushing the working image. | Read the message; ios.virtual.status and the job's log show the device's state, and docs/virtual-ios/troubleshooting.md lists known causes. |
| `workspace_busy` | This project already has an active build or app session. | Wait for the named job with job.wait, or cancel it with job.cancel if the person agrees; do not work on a copy of the project. |
| `workspace_missing` | Unknown workspace: … | workspace.list names the saved workspaces. |
| `xcode_import_failed` | A step Tomacco ran did not succeed. | Read the message and the job's log (job.logs); fix the cause and try again. |
| `xtool_project_required` | ship.sh builds xtool projects. | Create one with project.create kind xtool, or use project.import_xcode. |
